reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (frontend and checkoutservice) show slow calls converging on productcatalogservice, indicating productcatalogservice is the root cause.

productcatalogservice's own p95 latency is low (0.48ms), but callers see very high latency (checkoutservice->productcatalogservice avg 43.66ms, frontend->productcatalogservice avg 22.02ms), indicating requests queue before processing, typical of resource exhaustion.
CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 44% of its 10m CPU limit, which is very low absolute CPU but relative to the very low limit suggests CPU throttling.
productcatalogservice pod was recently recreated with a CPU limit reduced from 200m to 10m, likely causing resource exhaustion and increased latency.
No errors are observed, consistent with latency due to resource exhaustion rather than crashes or failures.
